page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top (PRÆFATIO. with page number 5 at top right). Main text in one column: the italic paragraph, then the signature line of Goclenius, centred to the right. Signature "A 3" at the bottom left and catchword "QUÆ-" at the bottom right. No marginal notes. Woodcut ornament between the text and the foot, not transcribed.

l.i: & utilis unquam: ut Magni illius artibus, quantumvis parvi artubus, Melanchthonus, qui magnum lumen & nomen in familiam tuam honestissimam & literatissimam infert, verbis utar. Data Marp. è Mu-seo meo, 24. Octobr. Anno 1596.

page.notes: The swash ornament before "Magni", "Melanchthonus", "Anno" and "Marp." is a decorative letter form, transcribed here as the plain word. A woodcut ornament (a grotesque mask with scrolls and tassels) stands in the middle of the page and is not text. Faint show-through of the reverse side appears in the body of the page and at the foot; it is left out.
